conflicts.claim_growth_design: Miller's Law states working memory capacity is 7 ± 2.
conflicts.reconciliation: Miller's Law applies to chunking in short-term memory, NOT visual UI list items. Visual UI list items rely on visual recognition rather than recall. Do NOT enforce 7-item limits on data tables or menus.
conflicts.resolution_status: RECONCILED (Scope restricted to short-term recall tasks)

conflicts.claim_apple_hig: Use crisp medium curves (6-8px) for structural dashboard containers on macOS.
conflicts.claim_general_ui: Use large rounded-3xl curves on mobile marketing cards.
conflicts.reconciliation: Structural enterprise dashboards MUST use 6-8px container curves for crisp alignment. Consumer marketing cards MAY use rounded-2xl curves.
